reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definition of lodging establishment
headings.reviewNote: Defines lodging establishment as building or facility providing five or more guest rooms.

headings.title: Guest property loss liability limit
headings.reviewNote: Caps lodging establishment liability at $200 absent written agreement; requires office delivery with claim check for money/jewelry/baggage (absent willful negligence/wrongdoing) and conspicuous desk and guest-room posting.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 1939-2002 history, and 1965 Phoenix Assur. Co. annotation (guest's automobile excluded); both headings retained and subsection 2 note corrected to remove ungrounded locked-room claim and capture claim-check/posting requirements.

headings.title: Innkeeper lien on guest baggage, property, and wages
headings.reviewNote: Grants inn, hotel, or boardinghouse keeper a lien on guest/boarder baggage, property, and wages for charges and advances up to $200, with detention right and exemption from attachment/execution.

headings.title: Retention and sale of lien property
headings.reviewNote: Requires 90-day retention before public auction after posting three county notices and mailing registered-address notice; unclaimed residue held 6 months for guest, 1 year by county treasurer, then state escheat fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1939/1949 history notes; expanded subsection 1 title/note to include guest wages and $200 advance cap, and corrected subsection 2 note to remove ungrounded 10-day notice claim.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines campground (five or more campsites) and campground owner.

headings.title: Posting and distribution of policies
headings.reviewNote: Mandates posting in high-traffic area or distribution of written policies on curfew, alcohol, tobacco, and pets.

headings.title: Grounds for ejectment of persons
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes campground owner to eject persons and notify local law enforcement for five enumerated grounds.

headings.title: First-degree trespass penalty and summary removal
headings.reviewNote: Makes remaining on campground after being asked to leave for a subsection 3 violation first-degree trespass under section 569.140 and authorizes summary removal by owner or law enforcement.

headings.title: Refund of unused prepaid fees
headings.reviewNote: Entitles removed person to refund of unused prepaid fees, prorated at daily rate, less amounts otherwise owed or deducted for damages.

headings.title: State park exemption
headings.reviewNote: Exempts all Missouri state parks from campground regulation provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2014 S.B. 735 history note; corrected subsection 4 title/note (summary removal, not restitution) and fixed subsections 3 and 5 notes (five grounds; no 30-day refund deadline).
